augments.name: Ultimate Unstoppable
augments.description: After using your Ultimate, you become immune to crowd control for 3 seconds. (8 second Cooldown).

augments.name: Ultra Hydra
augments.description:
Gain a Tiamat when completing a Hydra Item.
QUEST: Gain Ravenous Hydra, Profane Hydra and Titanic Hydra.
REWARD: Gain Ultra Hydra.

augments.name: Upgrade Collector
augments.description:
Executing enemies with The Collector's Passive increases its execute threshold and grants bonus Gold.
Gain 250 Gold.

augments.name: Upgrade Death's Dance
augments.description:
Gain @Gold@.
Death's Dance's Ignore Pain is increased to @RangeMeleeSplitTT@ of damage received, and heals for more instantly when scoring a takedown.

augments.name: Upgrade Immolate
augments.description: Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis grant 12 Gold per target affected with Immolate. Gain 250 Gold.

augments.name: Upgrade Infinity Edge
augments.description:
Gain 500 Gold.
Having Infinity Edge allows your Critical Strike Chance to grant random Critical Strike Damage each Attack.

augments.name: Upgrade Ravenous Hydra
augments.description:
Your spell hits trigger Cleave against enemies. Increase Ravenous Hydra's Life Steal to @LifeStealTT@
Gain 500 Gold.

augments.name: Upgrade Sheen
augments.description: Your Spellblade effects deal additional damage and heal you for a percent of the target's health. Additionally, gain 250 Gold.

augments.name: Upgrade Sundered Sky
augments.description: Upgrade Sundered Sky to reduce its per-target cooldown and heal you based on missing Health. Also gain Gold.

descriptionSource.reason: The Mayhem description expands from an indirect string reference to three unresolved cooldown, healing, and gold placeholders.

augments.name: Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn
augments.description:
Gain 100% Attack Speed.
Increase Sword of Blossoming Dawn's healing to 250% when you attack enemy champions.

augments.name: Upgrade Zhonya's
augments.description:
Reduce Zhonya's Hourglass Cooldown to 45 seconds. You can now move and gain Movement Speed when in Zhonya's Hourglass, Seeker's Armguard, or Wooglet's Witchcap stasis.
Gain 250 Gold.

augments.name: Urf's Champion
augments.description:
QUEST: Score @QuestRequirement@ takedowns.
REWARD: Golden Spatula

augments.name: Vampirism
augments.description: You cannot be healed by allies or gain Health Regen. Gain 25% Omnivamp.

augments.name: Veil of Warding
augments.description: Gain a Spell Shield every 30 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability.

augments.name: Void Dash
augments.description: Dashing with the affected ability spawns a Void Zone that Slows enemy champions and deals magic damage.

augments.name: Vulnerability
augments.description:
Your Item and damage over time effects can Critically Strike.
Gain 25% Crit chance.

augments.name: Warlock Juicebox
augments.description: Gain @Calc_Vamp@ Omnivamp.

augments.name: Wee Woo Wee Woo
augments.description: When moving towards allies with low Health, gain Movement Speed. Your Healing and Shielding are greater based on how low your target's Health is.

augments.name: Windspeaker's Blessing
augments.description: Your Healing and Shielding also increases the target's Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds.

augments.name: Witchful Thinking
augments.description: Gain @AP@ Ability Power.

augments.name: With Haste
augments.description: Gain Move Speed equal to 70% of your Ability Haste.

augments.name: Wooglet's Witchcap
augments.description:
Immediately gain a Needlessly Large Rod.
QUEST: Possess Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass.
REWARD: Gain Wooglet's Witchcap.

augments.name: Yowch, My Coins!
augments.description: On takedown, enemy champions drop coins nearby, which you and your allies can collect. Each is worth 15 gold.

augments.name: Zealot
augments.description: Gain @Calc_Crit_Chance@ Critical Strike Chance and @Calc_AS@ Attack Speed.
